# Open Model Family Tree

> The ancestry of every model on the Hugging Face Hub, rebuilt nightly from declared base_model metadata. Generated 2026-11-04 from the 2026-11-04 Hub dump.

- 3,208,041 models tracked, 917,769 declare a base model, 951,003 parent links, 90,683 models have descendants.
- Counts are unique descendants (finetunes, adapters, quantizations, merges), each counted once.
